wholePhysicalScope: Named native relation provides 36 outer controls with the portal projections and four inner court or lightwell polygons.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the wrapped palace wings, open roof voids, three porticos and central pediment. Near levels refine stone bands, full column profiles and sashes.
